content: Structure of an ImplementationDataType that represents a variable-sized array data type The ImplementationDataType that represents a Variable-Size Array Data Type shall have the category STRUCTURE that has two subElement s. The role of the subElement s with the definition of a Variable-Size Array Data Type is defined by [TPS_SWCT_01618], [TPS_SWCT_01619], [TPS_SWCT_01620], and [TPS_SWCT_01621].
